body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Berlin, Germany. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 5 km. It starts at Jewish Museum (Berlin), Lindenstraße 9-14, 10969 Berlin, Germany. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> This self-guided audio tour, with an entrance ticket to the Jewish Museum included, is perfect for those interested in the history, architecture, and cultural significance of Berlin.
>
> Please note that while the ticket to the Jewish Museum is included, the audio guide inside the museum is not provided.
>
> The tour begins at the Jewish Museum, a striking building with a unique zigzag design and the poignant Garden of Exile. Start with the free Core Exhibition. This ticket also gives access to The Opposite of Now Exhibition, where artists probe the existing order for an opening, a path to a different present.
>
> After you finish exploring the museum, unpause the tour and take a stroll along Berlin with an audio guide. You will walk to Checkpoint Charlie, the former border crossing between East and West Berlin, where you can see the replica of the original guardhouse and the border sign.
>
> As you continue, you will visit the Prinz Albrecht Palais, the former headquarters of the Gestapo and SS, now the site of the Topography of Terror outdoor museum. The tour also includes stops at Potsdamer Platz, Tiergarten Park, where you'll see the Beethoven-Haydn-Mozart Memorial and the Memorial to the Soviet Soldiers.
>
> The tour concludes at the Reichstag Building, the seat of the German parliament, where you can admire its impressive dome and reflect on the historical significance of the building.
